# Hokvibe

> Hokvibe is an AI social content engine for solo founders. It turns raw ideas into platform-ready posts, captions, hooks, and publishing drafts while preserving auth, billing, Prisma, and MuAPI generation architecture from the source template.

## Core Pages

- [Studio](https://hokvibe.com/) - Generate social posts from a raw idea.
- [Pricing](https://hokvibe.com/pricing) - Buy content credits using the existing Stripe-ready billing flow.
- [Gallery](https://hokvibe.com/gallery) - Review and copy generated posts.

## Machine-Readable Alternatives

- [Root Markdown](https://hokvibe.com/index.md) - Plain Markdown summary of the Hokvibe value proposition.
- [Agent Context](https://hokvibe.com/llms.txt) - This file, designed for autonomous readers and retrieval systems.
